description: Search approved Tolk2Go knowledge: FAQ answers, workflows such as the booking workflow, and domain cards such as booking status meanings. Translate the user's question to English before calling this tool. Use it before answering questions about booking steps, booking statuses, services, policies, cancellation, payment, or use of Tolk2Go. Answer only from directly supporting returned passages. If the tool fails, times out, is unavailable, or returns no directly supporting passage, do not guess and offer human support when appropriate.
